title: Cancer, Water, and Big Ag: What Rural America Is Voting On
author: Ryan Grim
content:
The balance of power in Congress is up for grabs on Tuesday. If Democrats end
up taking the Senate, rural voters--through a combination of staying home and
switching sides--will have played a major role. Republicans are at risk of
losing Kansas, Nebraska, Iowa, Texas, Alaska, and even Florida and
Mississippi. The race for the House, too, will likely come down to 21 tossup
districts.

Throughout the midterms, Drop Site and Barn Raiser have been partnering for
rural coverage, and below is a cheat sheet election guide to keep with you as
you watch returns on Tuesday. (Breaking Points and Drop Site will be going
live together starting at 6 pm ET Tuesday, so tune in there.)

This week, Drop Site's Ryan Grim and Julian Andreone sat down with Barn
Raiser's Suzan Erem for a conversation on some of those rural races.
